meta.method: binary structural parse: header -> keys/values/classes/objects -> NSIBObjectData graph -> NSNibOutletConnector / NSNibControlConnector -> NSClassSwapper frames / cell contents
limitations: Outlet -> target class is read from the destination object's NSClassName; for layout constraints the destination is an NSLayoutConstraint (no owning view is recorded in the archive).
NSFrame / NSFrameSize strings are IB design-time geometry; they are not live Auto Layout results.
Cell objects have no frame of their own; their owning control view frame is reported instead.
No NSPlaceholderString key exists in these archives, so text field placeholders are not recoverable (they are set in code).
NSLayoutConstraint relations (NSFirstItem/NSSecondItem/NSFirstAttribute/NSRelation) were parsed only as outlet targets; constraint constants were not resolved into spacing values.

pairs.en: Sorry, you've reached the use limit on checklist items. Upgrade now and add up to %1$d checklist items per task in %2$@.
pairs.zh: 抱歉，当前任务的检查事项数量已达上限。升级到高级会员，每个任务内可添加最多%1$d个检查事项，将大事情拆分成小执行步骤。

pairs.key: Sorry, you've reached the upper limit on check items.
pairs.en: Sorry, you've reached the upper limit on check items.
pairs.zh: 抱歉，当前任务的检查事项数量已达上限。

pairs.key: After switching to Check Item mode, the current layout will be invalid. Continue?
pairs.en: After switching to Checklist mode, the current layout will be invalid. Continue?
pairs.zh: 切换模式后，当前排版格式将失效，是否继续？

pairs.key: These %d tasks will be converted to subtasks of new merged one.
pairs.en: These %d tasks will be converted to subtasks of new merged one.
pairs.zh: %d个任务将以子任务形式合并为新任务。

pairs.en: %1$@ marked task %2$@ in shared list %3$@ as \"won't do\".
pairs.zh: %1$@ 在共享清单 %2$@ 中将任务 %3$@ 标记为“已放弃”。
%1$@ 在共享清单 %2$@ 中重新开始任务 %3$@。

pairs.key: Only unfinished tasks without subtasks can be converted
pairs.en: Only unfinished tasks without subtasks can be converted
pairs.zh: 只能转化没有子任务并且未完成的任务

pairs.key: Tasks with subtasks cannot be converted into notes
pairs.en: Tasks with subtasks cannot be converted to notes
pairs.zh: 有子任务，无法转化为笔记
正在生成完成建议和子任务
已生成完成建议和子任务

pairs.en: The current task already has subtasks. Would you like to replace them or add the new ones?
pairs.zh: 当前任务已有子任务，是否替换原有子任务或保留并添加子任务？

pairs.en: Sorry, you can add up to %d checklist items. Delete some to add more.
pairs.zh: 抱歉，检查事项数量已达上限。可删除部分检查事项后继续添加。
